issues.title: Vague Purpose and Audience
issues.description: The prompt states the portfolio is for 'software engineering purpose' but does not clarify what this entails — whether it's for job applications, freelance work, open source collaboration, or internal visibility. The target audience (recruiters, hiring managers, peers) is unspecified.

issues.title: Missing Features and Content
issues.description: No specification of what content should be included (e.g., bio, skills, projects, resume, blog, contact form). Without defined sections, the AI cannot determine structure or priority.

issues.title: No Technical Requirements
issues.description: The prompt does not specify frontend framework (React, Vue, plain HTML/CSS), hosting preference (static site, Vercel, Netlify), or interactivity level (animated, minimal, accessible).

issues.title: Absent UI/UX Expectations
issues.description: No mention of design preferences (modern, minimalist, dark mode), responsiveness requirements, or accessibility standards (WCAG).

issues.title: No Data or Integration Details
issues.description: Unclear if the portfolio should pull data from external sources (GitHub API, LinkedIn), host static content, or include a backend for contact forms.

suggestions: Clarify the primary goal of the portfolio (e.g., job search, freelance branding).
List required sections: bio, skills, projects, resume download, contact form.
Specify technical stack preferences (e.g., React + Tailwind CSS, or plain HTML/CSS/JS).
Define responsiveness and accessibility expectations (mobile-friendly, WCAG 2.1 AA).
Mention if animations, dark mode, or blog integration are desired.
Note hosting preferences (e.g., deploy to Vercel, GitHub Pages).
improvedPrompt: Build a personal portfolio webpage for a software engineer seeking full-time employment. The site should showcase professional background, technical skills, project experience, and provide a way for recruiters to contact me. Include the following sections: Hero (name, title, short bio), Skills (categorized: languages, frameworks, tools), Projects (3–5 highlighted projects with title, description, tech stack, GitHub/live links, and screenshots), Resume (PDF download link), and Contact (form with name, email, message, and optional LinkedIn/GitHub links). Use React with Tailwind CSS for styling, ensuring the site is fully responsive and meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards. Implement a light/dark mode toggle. Host the site on Vercel. No backend is needed — the contact form should use Formspree or EmailJS for submission. Prioritize clean, modern UI with subtle animations on scroll and hover.

explanation.change: Defined clear purpose: job search for software engineering role
explanation.reason: Establishes intent and helps prioritize content and tone
Ensures the AI knows what content to include and structure around
explanation.change: Specified exact sections: Hero, Skills, Projects, Resume, Contact
Chose React + Tailwind CSS as the tech stack
explanation.reason: Provides clear implementation direction while allowing flexibility

explanation.change: Added responsiveness, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), and dark mode
explanation.reason: Addresses key UX and inclusivity expectations for a professional portfolio
Eliminates ambiguity about deployment and backend needs

explanation.change: Prioritized modern UI with subtle animations
explanation.reason: Sets expectations for polish without over-engineering
